reason: Booking.com is where my guests already find me and trust the payment. A pretty site and an app for a 12-room place sounds nice, but my guests don't download apps, and I'm not paying $800 to fight Booking.com when my template site already works.
objection: Will guests really book on my own site and send a deposit by M-Pesa when they already trust Booking.com? I've heard of owners losing bookings that way.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a guesthouse like mine, in Lamu or Diani, that direct bookings went up by enough to cover the fee and the cost of the site, shown to me in numbers.
